content: Xoossay Babiloone Seerana
Amoxe na7ay, Isayaasi Goday Babilooneba qoncisin be7idaysi haysa.
Aykoy bayna deriya bolla malla essidi, hinte qaala dhoqu oothidi waassite; enti halaqata pengiyara gelana mela wuttite.
Taani hanqetidaysata seerana mela ta geeshshata kiittas; ta xoonoy ufaysiya ta wolqaamata xeegas.
Daro asay wocameysada deriya huuphiyan de7iya wocamaa si7ite! Qassi kawotethati issife shiiqidi palamiya palama si7ite! Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday olanchota olas giigisis.
Godaynne iya hanqo ola miishey biitta ubbaa dhaysanaw haaho biittafe, salo gaxape yoosona.
Godaa gallasay matida gisho yeekite! He gallasay Ubbaafe Wolqaama Xoossaa matape dhaysanaw yaana.
Hessa gisho, yashshan enta kushey doccana; asa ubbaa wozanay til7ana.
Enti dagammana; iqethinne un7etethi enta oykana. Yelo keyida maccasada enti inxaxana. Enti dagammidi issoy issuwa xeellana; enta som7oy bido gidis.
Heko biitta baysa kessanawunne iyan de7iya nagaranchota dhaysanaw yiloninne suullida hanqon Godaa gallasay yaana.
Salo xoolintotinne xoolinto koceti banta poo7uwa diggana; doliya away dhumana; ageenayka ba poo7uwa immenna.
Goday, “Taani ha sa7aa iya iitatethaa gisho, iitataka enta nagara gisho seerana. Taani otoranchota otoruwa shaarana; iitata ceequwa kawushana.
Attidaysati walahi bayna worqafe al7o gidana; asa na7i Ofira worqafe aadhidi boncho gidana.
Hessa gisho, Ubbaafe Wolqaama Godaa hanquwan, iya hanquwa suulaa gallas, taani salota kokorsana; sa7aaka iya bessaafe qaathana” yaagees.
Shankafe baqatiya gaarada woyko heemmiya asi bayna dorsa wudeda asi ubbay ba asaako simmana; ubbay ba biitta baqatana.
Bentida oonika cadetana; oyketida oonika mashshan hayqana.
Enta guutha nayti enta sinthan busetana; enta keethay bonqetana; enta macheta hara asi iissana.
Bira koyonnanne worqan ufaytonna Meedona asaa taani enta bolla denthana.
Enta dongey na7atethata wodhana; yooga naytaka maarokona; enta ayfey naytas qadhetenna.
Kawotethatas boncho, ba asaas alleeqo gidida Babiloone biitta, Goday Sodoomedanne Gamoorada shiri yeggana.
He biittan asi uttenna; woyko yeletaape yeletaa gakanaw yan asi deenna. Arabe asay yan banta dunkaaniya tolokona; dorse heemmeysatika yan banta wudiya heemmokona.
Shin bazzo do7ati yan aqana; workanati enta keethaa kumana; guttoti yan daana; yanchoti yan keexana; bazzo deeshati yan gupana.
Enta keethatan godarey waassana; enta kawo gadhon workanati boccana. Iya wodey matis; iya gallasayka gam7enna.
